title: Otter.ai raises $320 million from General Catalyst’s growth fund for its meeting tool
script:
Otter.ai just secured three hundred twenty million dollars.
General Catalyst backed the meeting note-taking tool through its Customer Value Fund.
The fund supplies capital without diluting equity while taking returns on marketing results.
Otter.ai will pump the cash into enterprise growth and international expansion.
The company also plans heavy investments in product innovation.
Would you let an AI take minutes in your next meeting?
